label: thm:aomega-fourone-dt-count
title: The figure-eight Stokes integer $A_\omega(4_1) = 3$ is a BPS/DT count (conditional on the Stokes--DT--BPS bridge)
html:
Theorem (conditional on conj:stokes-dt-bps-bridge). Under the closed-sector Stokes--DT--BPS bridge, the G3 Stokes integer of the figure-eight 4_1 is a BPS/DT count:

  A_\omega(4_1) \;=\; \dim \mathcal{H}_{\mathrm{BPS}}\big(T[4_1]\big) \;=\; 3 .

Derivation (through the bridge)

The bridge supplies two identifications, valid for every knot K:

  \mathfrak{S}(K) \;\overset{\text{GGM 3(d)}}{=}\; \Omega_{\mathrm{DT}}(K)
  \;\overset{\text{GPPV}}{=}\; \dim \mathcal{H}_{\mathrm{BPS}}(T[K]) .

Specialise to K = 4_1 and feed the bridge-independent, certified Stokes datum: the Garoufalidis--Gu--Mariño eq-(60) q \to 0 off-diagonal of the 4_1 Stokes matrix is \mathfrak{S}(4_1) = S^+(0)_{01} = 3, proved unconditionally by decidable integer-matrix algebra from the certified GGM/DGG q-series W_{-1}(0) in QOU.QBeta.StokesQZeroDTCount. Composing,

  \dim \mathcal{H}_{\mathrm{BPS}}(T[4_1])
  \;\overset{\text{GPPV}}{=}\; \Omega_{\mathrm{DT}}(4_1)
  \;\overset{\text{GGM 3(d)}}{=}\; \mathfrak{S}(4_1)
  \;=\; 3 .

The value 3 enters only from the certified Stokes computation; the bridge class asserts no value of A_\omega. So the theorem derives that the figure-eight observable A_\omega is the BPS degeneracy of T[4_1] and equals 3 — it does not assume it (the non-degeneracy requirement of the bridge class).

Scope

This is a theorem for 4_1 — Garoufalidis--Gu--Mariño proved peacock Conjecture 3 for the figure-eight, so the bridge instance is discharged there; the general statement (all hyperbolic knots) is the open conjecture conj:stokes-dt-bps-bridge. The result is conditional on that adopted bridge and is not carried downstream: no mass prediction and no rung of the Q_\beta ladder depends on it. The internal derivation of the integer 3 from the QOU categorical drivers (Hecke H_3 / Bring / Wedderburn), rather than importing it from Garoufalidis--Gu--Mariño, remains open.

The bridge here is the closed / state-integral BPS sector. The open-HOMFLY Gukov--Stošić bridge gives the 4_1 count \det(4_1) = 5 (five HOMFLY-homology generators / five quiver nodes) and does not reproduce \{3, 4\} — see the non-degeneracy discussion in conj:stokes-dt-bps-bridge.
